executed: all records are actual executions of the engine; designs are hand-written AI-style inputs, not Gemini output

records.title: Serving board
records.prompt: A 400 x 250 mm serving board from 18 mm plywood with a handle, a 20 mm hanging hole and an engraved line.

records.title: Multi-compartment bookshelf
records.prompt: A 1200 x 1800 x 300 mm bookshelf in 18 mm plywood with three columns, three shelves per column, a plinth and a 6 mm back. Glue-free.

records.title: Cabinet with door and drawers
records.prompt: A 900 x 800 x 580 mm cabinet: left bay with a hinged door, right bay with two drawers. 18 mm plywood.
records.notes: Drawers are drawn as boxes resting on their runners: the format has no sliding joint.

records.title: Chair (fixed version of a folding chair)
records.prompt: A folding chair, 450 mm wide, seat at 418 mm, backrest leaning back 8 degrees. 18 mm plywood.
records.notes: Folding (pivots) is not representable; this is the rigid equivalent.

records.title: Complex computer desk
records.prompt: A 1400 x 750 x 700 mm computer desk: left pedestal with a shelf and a drawer, right leg panel, modesty panel, keyboard tray hung under the top and a monitor riser on top. 18 mm plywood.

records.title: Stepped multi-level storage
records.prompt: A stepped storage unit with three columns of 1200, 800 and 400 mm height, 1218 x 350 mm footprint, 18 mm plywood.

records.title: Three-plate interlocking puzzle
records.prompt: A wooden puzzle: three 120 mm square 6 mm plates that slot together at right angles through each other.
records.notes: Three plates crossing in all three axes cannot be assembled with simple halving notches (each pair needs notches from opposite edges that block the third plate); the engine must reject it, not produce it.

first_errors: Board 'PX': the joint cuts split the board or leave a hole in it — check its finger / cross_lap connections.
Board 'PY': the joint cuts split the board or leave a hole in it — check its finger / cross_lap connections.
Board 'PZ': the joint cuts split the board or leave a hole in it — check its finger / cross_lap connections.

records.title: Stackable modular cubes
records.prompt: Two identical 400 mm open storage cubes in 18 mm plywood that stack on top of each other.

records.title: Electronics enclosure
records.prompt: A 240 x 100 x 160 mm enclosure in 6 mm plywood: finger-jointed walls, an internal divider, vent slots, a 20 mm cable hole and a lift-off engraved lid.

records.title: Acoustic guitar
records.prompt: An acoustic guitar: 500 x 380 mm body with a 90 mm sound hole, 100 mm deep, neck and headstock.
records.notes: Bent ribs, a laminated neck joint and carved parts cannot be expressed; the engine must reject, not fake it.

first_errors: Connection 'n-t': no end face of 'NECK' meets a broad face of 'TOPPLATE'. For tab_slot, an edge of 'NECK' must sit against the flat face of 'TOPPLATE' (they must overlap side-on, and 'TOPPLATE''s thickness axis must point at 'NECK').

records.title: Wooden boat (native example)
records.prompt: The built-in parametric boat model (native engine format).

design_json.name: Day Sailer (board model)
design_json.description: Glue-free parametric sailing boat: every part locks in with tabs and slots — bottom, four hull side panels, transom, two bulkheads, deck with cockpit, keel, rudder, mast and two sails.

records.title: Punt model, vertical sides
records.prompt: A 600 mm flat-bottom punt model in 6 mm plywood with vertical sides, transom, bow board and a seat.

records.title: Punt model, flared sides
records.prompt: The same punt with sides flared outwards by 15 degrees.
records.notes: Needs bevelled edges, which the format cannot express.

first_errors: Connection 'sb': no straight edge of 'SIDE-B' sits flat against a face of 'BOTTOM'. With "rotate", an edge of 'SIDE-B' must be parallel to a broad face of 'BOTTOM' and run over it (e.g. a gable's sloped top edge under a roof panel tilted to the same pitch).

Connection 'sf': no straight edge of 'SIDE-F' sits flat against a face of 'BOTTOM'. With "rotate", an edge of 'SIDE-F' must be parallel to a broad face of 'BOTTOM' and run over it (e.g. a gable's sloped top edge under a roof panel tilted to the same pitch).

records.title: Wall-mounted shelf
records.prompt: A 600 mm wall shelf, 200 mm deep, screwed to the wall through a back rail, with two triangular brackets.
